```{r}
#| label: tbl-timeline
#| tbl-cap: Үйл явдлын хураангуй

reactable(
  mining_timeline,
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  bordered = FALSE,
  pagination = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 15,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
  pageSizeOptions = c(10, 15, 25, 50),

  language = reactableLang(
    searchPlaceholder = "Хайх...",
    noData = "Өгөгдөл байхгүй",
    pageInfo = "{rowStart}–{rowEnd} / {rows} мөр",
    pagePrevious = "Өмнөх",
    pageNext = "Дараах",
    pageSizeOptions = "Харуулах {rows} мөр"
  ),

  columns = list(

    year = colDef(
      name = "Он",
      width = 70,
      align = "center"
    ),

    category = colDef(
      name = "Ангилал",
      width = 150
    ),

    event = colDef(
      name = "Үйл явдал",
      minWidth = 300
    ),

    actors = colDef(
      name = "Оролцогч талууд",
      minWidth = 220
    ),

    commodity = colDef(
      name = "Бүтээгдэхүүн",
      width = 140
    ),

    significance = colDef(
      name = "Ач холбогдол",
      minWidth = 350
    )
  )
)
```
